description: generateDomainSuggestions: Generate domain name suggestions based on keywords. This is the preferred suggestion tool for a single keyword; use it over suggestAlternatives. Returns suggested names with availability.

name.description: Keyword or base name to build suggestions from, e.g. "mycompany".

tlds.description: Comma-separated TLDs without leading dots, e.g. "com,net".
